cn2.text: Grenzo is a goblin dungeon keeper locked out of his dungeons by Marchesa, and after her crowning Daretti allies with the disenfranchised goblins under Grenzo to take revenge.

A mob of goblins draws off a sentry, and Grenzo smashes in the villa door with his staff and floods the foyer with looters, while Daretti finds blueprints bearing the Academy seal for one of the first cogwork sentries.

Grenzo tells Daretti that the Academy is dead and Muzzio exiled, and Daretti tells him to burn everything, so the goblins burn the manuscript, smash the furniture and pour oil on the pile until the fire takes hold of the villa; Daretti discovers the plagiarism and kills Fimarell.

Daretti names Alendis as his next target, while Grenzo adds anyone in league with Marchesa and proposes crashing all their parties; elsewhere Grenzo infiltrates Adriana's gatherings and turns peaceful demonstrations into violent mobs.
